title: Reporting Questions: Rules and Examples — Quiz 131A

## Reporting Questions: Rules and Examples

Review reporting verbs, connectors and statement word order for indirect questions.

### Lesson focus

1. “Is the food ready?” → He asked if the food was ready.
2. “Where is mother?” → He wanted to know where his mother was.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
